authorized_observation.protocol: OPEN_INDEX sends company-owner IDs to R; OPEN_VAULT sends the request to Vault. Counts and city data are fetched separately in either order. FETCH_CITY_BUNDLE includes owner addresses; REQUEST_CITY_PROJECTION then PROJECT_CITIES then SEND_CITIES removes addresses. JOIN combines company names, counts and cities. Vault additionally requires SEND_JOIN_RESULT. JOIN has explicit read access to public company names. Projection and DELIVER_RESULT consume actual delivered results, never a shared result cache.
